name: autoplay-toggle
title: Autoplay toggle
description: The pause control moving content must have: one button to stop and start a carousel, ticker or video, with a hook that also holds it on hover, focus and hidden tabs.
docs: label says what it controls and is part of the name (Pause testimonials, Play testimonials). Let useAutoplay own the state, spread contentProps on the moving content and read running in the timer; there is no aria-pressed because the name already follows the state.
